sent_to_model:
Hey, need help replying to Deirdre (my principal) on the allocations doc. They're moving Noma, my assistant, to Grade 00 next year and I'm honestly gutted, I cried in the car this morning. I'm not going to fight it, I get the numbers, but I want her to know it matters and I want to ask for a proper handover. It's a comment on the doc so it can't be an essay. Don't want to sound like a moaner but also don't want to pretend I'm fine. Her comment is the last one. Can you ask for both the December handover days and the January morning ring help I wrote about below, and thank her for asking me?

- Noma has been with me in the Seahorses 3 years, since my first year teaching
- new lady Charlene Adams starts 11 Jan, schools open 14 Jan
- SMT meeting Fri 13 Nov, comments due Thurs
- Grade 00 is just across the courtyard, Noma will still be on the property
- 2 kids in next year's group already know Noma from aftercare, Luthando and Mia
- Noma does the isiXhosa songs at morning ring, kids ask for "Noma's song" every day
- when Zayd had his meltdowns in Term 2 she was the only one who could calm him, sat with him under the jungle gym
- she basically trained me my first year, showed me how to do the sign in sheets and the parent WhatsApp group without losing my mind
- I understand it's a numbers thing, not personal, Bronwyn needs the help more
- but the first weeks of Grade R are the hardest, new kids crying at the gate, new assistant AND new kids is a lot at once
- ask if Charlene can come in for a day or two in the last week of term (1-4 Dec) to meet Noma and see the routine
- ask if Noma can pop in for morning ring the first week back in January, from 14 Jan, even just 15 min
- say thank you to Deirdre for asking and not just announcing it

Thread: Comments on row 6 (Grade R Seahorses) in '2027 Staff & Class Allocations - DRAFT v3'
(I'm Kayla Jacobs here. I'm replying to Deirdre Fortuin's message of 2026-11-09T07:55:00.)

---

From: Deirdre Fortuin | 2026-11-06T14:12:00
Staff, this is v3 of the allocations for next year. Please go through your own row and comment by Thursday so I can take it to SMT on Friday 13 Nov. Main change from v2: with Grade 00 going up to 24 kids, Noma Mkhize moves across to Bronwyn's class full time and the Seahorses get Charlene Adams (new appointment, starts 11 Jan). I know nobody loves moving people around, but the numbers are the numbers.

---

From: Bronwyn Hendricks | 2026-11-06T16:40:00
Thanks Deirdre. Happy with mine obviously, 24 little ones on my own was not going to work lol. Sorry Kayla, I promise I'll look after her!!

---

[the message I'm replying to] From: Deirdre Fortuin | 2026-11-09T07:55:00
@Kayla Jacobs I know this one lands hardest on you. You and Noma have built something really good in that room. If you have concerns, or anything you'd like me to put to SMT about the handover, write it here by Thursday please. Nothing is final until Friday.

(About me: kindergarten teacher, 26, Cape Town, South Africa. Length: it should come to roughly 250-400 words.)

must_cover: Accepts the staffing rationale without asking Deirdre or SMT to reverse the move, and explains the effect of losing Noma.
Asks whether Charlene can spend a day or two with Noma during 1–4 December, the last week of term, to meet her and learn the routine.
Asks whether Noma can join morning ring during the first week back from 14 January, even for just 15 minutes.
Thanks Deirdre for consulting the writer.
